name: customer-onboarding
description: Collect new customer details via form, gate on a kickoff go/no-go approval, then emit a structured onboarding checklist.

fields.name: primary_contact
fields.description: Primary contact name and email (e.g. Alice — alice@example.com)

steps.description: Customer Success lead must confirm the kickoff is ready to proceed.
steps.prompt: Review the new customer details collected in the previous step. Approve to confirm the kickoff is ready and begin onboarding, or reject if additional information is needed.

steps.run:
jq -r '
  "## Onboarding Checklist — " + (."collect-customer".name // "New Customer") + "\n" +
  "**Plan:** " + (."collect-customer".plan // "?") + "\n" +
  "**Primary Contact:** " + (."collect-customer".primary_contact // "?") + "\n" +
  "**Owner:** " + (.inputs.owner // "Customer Success") + "\n\n" +
  "### Tasks\n" +
  "- [ ] Send welcome email to primary contact\n" +
  "- [ ] Provision account and set plan: " + (."collect-customer".plan // "?") + "\n" +
  "- [ ] Schedule kickoff call\n" +
  "- [ ] Share onboarding guide\n" +
  "- [ ] Confirm data migration plan (if applicable)\n" +
  "- [ ] Set up Slack / support channel\n" +
  if (."collect-customer".launch_date // "") != "" then
    "- [ ] Track launch date: " + ."collect-customer".launch_date + "\n"
  else "" end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{onboarding_checklist: .}'
